text:
maria: noticing steady memory growth on host-gpu-12 during long-context chats from tenant-pg. p95 latency stable but resident set climbs ~200MB over 30m.

maria: pprof snapshot shows lots of 'page object' allocations coming from kv slab reuse, not new allocations. suspect fragmentation / slab wearout.

jin: can you paste pprof snippet?

maria: ```
(pprof) top
100MB  40%  ... runtime.mallocgc
45MB   18%  ... kv/page_map
22MB   9%   ... runtime.slaballoc
# suspicious: page_map refcounts growing
```

sam: interesting. is this only longctx workloads? any noisy tenant correlation?

maria: yes. correlated with a single tenant doing many long-context chat sessions. other tenants unaffected.

rajesh: @maria can you check minor/major page fault counters? ops saw increased page-ins.

maria: minor PFs spike when KV pages are evicted then relanded; we see reuse hits but not enough compaction.

lisa: could be slab size classes causing internal fragmentation, especially with variable KV page sizes from quantized models.

jin: we should simulate slab 'wearout' where repeated longctx allocations pin certain size classes. I'd run the multi-tenant sim with skewed request sizes.

maria: started a short sim: `./tools/kv-sim --tenants=20 --hot=1 --longctx=80k --duration=10m` results show steady residency shift to tenant-hot and evict churn.

sam: any delta after enabling per-tenant min-watermark? (we had that patch last sprint)

maria: with min-watermark=32MB, eviction churn reduced but noisy tenant still grows memory ~60MB over baseline.

jin: suggests adding per-tenant eviction cooldown: don't evict same page more than X times per minute. might reduce thrash.

lisa: also track 'age' histogram per-page for reuse heuristics. if reuse probability low, consider larger compaction sweep.

rajesh: ops: can we trial tenant hard cap on nodes serving longctx for a bit? need to test failover.

maria: ok I can spin a canary with `tenant_cap=2` and extra logging. posting logs in #eng-sre.

perf-bot: test-run started 2219876600: kv-sim-run id=kv-2219

sam: action items: 1) maria run canary + attach pprof (due EOD), 2) jin build sim to reproduce fragment wearout (due tomorrow), 3) lisa add per-page age histogram (WIP), 4) rajesh coordinate tenant cap trial (ops)

maria: noted. will also dump KV slab stats: `slab_stats --summary` and paste.

maria: ```
slab class 32MB: allocated 512, free 8, avg_fill=0.98
slab class 64MB: allocated 128, free 1, avg_fill=0.99
frag estimate: 18%
```

jin: that avg_fill is alarming — likely internal fragmentation. maybe reduce size class granularity or do periodic compaction to reclaim.

sam: let's avoid big changes in prod tonight. prefer simulated patches + canary.

maria: agreed. will post sim artifacts and a short postmortem if the canary reproduces.

lisa: note for roadmap: consider 'tenant wearout' metric per-node to trigger automatic tenant reshuffle.

maria: tagging @lisa @jin @rajesh — will update here when canary finishes :hourglass:
